title: Average and Median Starting Salaries for Social Workers
what_it_is: Average and Median Starting Salaries for Social Workers

sections.label: Social worker salary guidelines
sections.summary: MSF and NCSS guide the sector on competitive salaries, and NCSS publishes annually updated salary guidelines that most SSAs adopt.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: The figures are comparable with the salaries for all fresh graduates, including those without a Social Work Degree, in those years, based on the Graduate Employment Survey (GES) conducted by the Autonomous Universities.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: MSF and the National Council of Social Service (NCSS) are committed in guiding the sector to pay competitive salaries for all social service professionals, including social workers.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: NCSS publishes sector salary guidelines for a range of professions in the social service sector.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: The guidelines are updated annually to keep pace with competing market and general wage movements.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: The majority of SSAs adopt the guidelines and we strongly encourage SSAs to adhere to these guidelines to reward and retain good staff.

sections.label: Guidelines and market competition
sections.summary: The guidelines are updated annually for market competition, and the speaker says market forces should not be intervened with unless drastically bad.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: As I mentioned to the Member and the Members of this House, the guidelines are updated annually to keep pace with a competing market, so it is not just about the competition between SSAs, but also competition for qualified staff that will move out of the sector to other sectors too.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Therefore, we want to make sure that it is at the level, which commensurate with the skills and the market competition that these graduates or social workers can face.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: I think we should not get ahead of ourselves and we should not intervene with market forces, unless it is drastically bad for our social workers.
